title: ACHIRI — Implement extended_memory tier gating
description: The extended_memory feature is listed in Achiri config for tnd_basic and tnd_premium tiers but not implemented. All tiers currently get the same 50-turn history. This sprint implements tier-based memory: free=50 turns, tnd_basic=200, tnd_premium=500. Also gates memory search injection and profile extraction on extended_memory feature.
